events.comment: Shared combat rules. Runs before the Gunslinger events so they can react on the same frame.
Gunslinger scene start: play this scene's music.
Gunslinger: pick how many player hits (1-5) it takes before the first dash.
Gunslinger: keep its HP bar 3px above its head. The hitbox starts at the top of the head, so BoundingBoxTop is the head. The posture bar stays at the top of the screen on the UI layer.
Gunslinger: AI runs by default. AIPaused is worked out again every frame.
Gunslinger: pause the AI while stunned.
Gunslinger: pause the AI once the player is deleted.
Gunslinger: after a posture break, it waits RecoverAttackDelay seconds (1) once the stun ends before it attacks again. The AI stays paused meanwhile, standing idle.

Gunslinger: posture broke, so cancel its dashes and play gunslinger_posture_broken. It does not loop, so it holds the last frame until the stun ends; the AI is paused meanwhile, and once it recovers the range attacks switch it back to a gun animation.
Gunslinger: player deleted, so cancel its dashes and stand idle once.

Phase 2 gun speed: in phase 2 (Lives <= 1) the pistol, shotgun and sniper animations play GunAnimSpeedP2 times faster. GunAnimSpeedNow also speeds up WeaponAnimTime below, so each shot still fires on the same animation frame and each cycle ends when its animation does. The stun sniper shot keeps normal speed, because it is timed by its own timer. Every other animation (idle, dashes, posture broken) always plays at normal speed.

Weapon lock: CanSwitchWeapon is true unless a gun animation is still mid-cycle. WeaponAnimTime counts the current gun animation; when it reaches the cycle length the cycle is done and switching is allowed for that frame. Cycle length = frames x 0.08s (pistol 0.8, shotgun 1.92, sniper 3.2).

When Player posture reaches MaxPosture, Gunslinger retreats to the far arena end, plays the sniper animation, and fires a dedicated 20-damage sniper bullet. Normal attacks and dash logic are locked until this shot sequence ends.
If Gunslinger is already at the selected sniper position (within 8 pixels), end the reposition dash immediately and begin the sniper wind-up.
If Gunslinger is already at the selected sniper position (within 8 pixels), end the reposition dash immediately and begin the sniper wind-up.
Close < 300: shotgun | Mid 300-700: pistol | Long > 700: sniper. Skipped while dashing.

Facing: turn toward the player. While a shotgun cycle is playing it keeps its facing, so getting behind it mid-shot does not turn it around. It can turn again on the frame the cycle ends (CanSwitchWeapon).

Assault: choose one forward dash destination from Gunslinger's world side. The dash completes in that direction without an automatic retreat phase. Dash lock remains active until the movement tween has finished. On collision during a forward dash, knock Player away. Every voluntary dash (assault, feint combo, contact retreat, hit reaction, corner escape) also needs CanSwitchWeapon, so it waits for the current pistol, shotgun or sniper cycle to finish instead of cutting the attack short. The stun sniper reposition is the one exception: it interrupts on purpose.

Dash tuning per phase. Phase 2 (Lives <= 1) dashes more: a shorter assault cooldown (AssaultCooldownP2 instead of P1 seconds), a higher feint combo chance (FeintChanceP2 instead of P1 percent) and a quicker retreat when the player stays in contact (TouchDashTimeP2 instead of P1 seconds). The Now variables hold whichever applies and are read by the assault, feint and contact dash events.

Feint combo: FeintChanceNow percent chance (30 in phase 1, 55 in phase 2) when an assault opportunity is available. Gunslinger rapidly crosses the arena four times, alternating sides, with collision knockback.
PlatformerObject handles walls automatically; Separate + tween-stop covers dash-tween clipping.
Fire once per weapon cycle, on a set frame of the gun animation (pistol frame 6, shotgun frame 15, sniper frame 30). The time is WeaponFireTime = (frame - 1) x 0.08s, set when the weapon switches.
Gun sound for this shot: pistol, shotgun or sniper, on the same frame the bullets spawn.
Pistol/sniper: one bullet fired straight at the player. Shotgun: 5 pellets in a half-circle burst (-30, -15, 0, +15, +30 degrees around the aim line), 3 damage and 1 posture each.
Pistol and sniper bullets can be deflected by the player's sword (see Gunslinger_Bullet_Damage). Sniper bullets also fly at SniperBulletSpeed instead of 700.
Phase 2: this shot starts a fan burst. The extra shots are fired by Gunslinger_Phase2_Pistol_Fan.

Shotgun aim: at the player when the player is in front. If the player is behind it (facing is locked during the shot), the burst fires straight ahead instead. Unflipped faces left, flipped faces right.

Phase 2 pistol fanning: after the normal pistol shot, the Gunslinger fans the hammer and fires FanShots more bullets. The first comes FanGap1 seconds later, each one after that FanGap2 seconds later, so the rhythm is shot, shot, beat, shot and mashing deflect gets punished. Each extra bullet is a normal pistol bullet (10 damage, 15 posture, parryable) aimed at the player with up to FanSpread degrees of random spread. With the default timings the burst ends at 0.65s, inside the 0.8s pistol cycle.
Cancel the burst if the Gunslinger stops shooting the pistol: weapon switch, dash, posture break, or AI paused.
Next fan shot is due.
Bullets damage the player like melee hits (rally + posture), then are destroyed.
For each bullet: if it touches the player, damage once and delete it. Per-bullet so shotgun pellets that land on the same frame all count.

Deflect: a Parryable (pistol) bullet that reaches the player within DeflectWindowNow seconds (DeflectWindow, widened by Desperation in Combat_Shared) of raising the sword is sent back at the Gunslinger, with a random clash sound, spark, hit-stop and screen shake, same as the shared deflect in combat_shared. Deflected makes the damage and delete events below skip it, and the return hit is handled after this loop.

Deflect sound: one of the 21 echo clashes at random (7 pitches x 3 takes, made by tools/fx/clash.js), so repeated deflects never sound identical. Replaces sword_parry_01.wav. Also draws the new spark additively, so its glow lights up its surroundings.

inlineCode: // Deflect sound: a random echo clash. The files are deflect_clash_<pitch>_echo[_b|_c].wav in assets/Sfx,
// generated by tools/fx/clash.js (rerun it to change them). Volume 51: 40% under the old parry sound (85), which was too loud with these.
// Spark light: the new Deflect_Spark is drawn additively, so its glow halo brightens what is behind it like real light.
for (const s of runtimeScene.getObjects("Deflect_Spark")) if (!s.__lit) { s.__lit = true; s.setBlendMode(1); }

events.comment: Deflected bullet reaches the Gunslinger: it takes the bullet's Damage to Health and ParryPostureDamage to Posture (Gunslinger_NPC.ParryPosturePistol, ParryPosturePistolP2 in phase 2, or ParryPostureSniper, set when the bullet is fired), posture recovery restarts, and the bullet is destroyed. No damage while Invulnerable, but the bullet is still destroyed.

Range limit: a bullet with MaxDistance above 0 (shotgun pellets, set from Gunslinger_NPC.ShotgunRange) is destroyed once it has travelled that far from where it spawned. Pistol and sniper bullets keep MaxDistance 0, so they have no limit.

Phase 2 (Gunslinger on its last life, Lives <= 1): every GrenadeMinDelay to GrenadeMaxDelay seconds, at random, it lobs GrenadeCount (3) grenades in an arc. Each lands within GrenadeSpread pixels of the player, in its own slice of that range so they don't stack, on the ground at GrenadeGroundY, waits GrenadeFuse seconds, then explodes. The explosion is in the EnemyHitbox group, so Combat_Shared handles the damage, hit reaction, roll i-frames and deflect. Art is a placeholder: the bullet sprite and the deflect flash, tinted. Each grenade explosion that hurts the player heals the Gunslinger by GrenadeHeal, up to MaxHealth.
Phase 2 starts: raise MaxPosture to MaxPostureP2 (2500) once, and resize the enemy posture bar to match.
Phase 2 starts: arm the grenade timer once, with a random first delay.

Throw: when the delay is up, and the Gunslinger is not stunned, paused or busy with the stun sniper shot, it lobs GrenadeCount grenades at once. The landing spots are picked now and stay fixed, so the player can read them and move.

Throw: create the grenades one at a time. GrenadeSlot counts them 0, 1, 2: the range Player.CenterX() +/- GrenadeSpread is cut into GrenadeCount equal slices, and grenade n lands at a random spot in the middle of slice n (20% to 80% across), so neighbours are always at least 40% of a slice apart.
Flight: move along a straight line from start to target, lifted by a parabola that peaks at ArcHeight halfway. It lands exactly on the target after FlightTime seconds, spinning as it goes.

parameters: lerp(Grenade.Variable(StartY), Grenade.Variable(TargetY), min(Grenade.Variable(T) / Grenade.Variable(FlightTime), 1)) - Grenade.Variable(ArcHeight) * 4 * min(Grenade.Variable(T) / Grenade.Variable(FlightTime), 1) * (1 - min(Grenade.Variable(T) / Grenade.Variable(FlightTime), 1))

events.comment: Landed: after Fuse seconds, explode. The explosion is the deflect flash, tinted orange and scaled up, and shakes the screen.

Heal: when a grenade explosion hurts the player, the Gunslinger heals GrenadeHeal HP, capped at MaxHealth. Combat_Shared sets JustHitPlayer on the frame an EnemyHitbox damages the player, and Grenade_Explosion is the only EnemyHitbox in this scene, so a deflected explosion or a bullet never heals. Each explosion can hit only once (HasHit), so this is once per grenade hit; explosions that land on the player on the same frame deal their damage once, and heal once. Not at 0 HP, so a heal can't undo a deathblow.
Remove the explosion when its animation ends.

Phase 2 (Lives <= 1): when the Gunslinger starts sniping it drops a smoke bomb at its feet and stands behind the cloud, which is drawn in front of it. Smoke_Bomb plays three animations: Smoke_Start once, then Smoke on loop for as long as the sniper attack lasts, then Smoke_End once when the Gunslinger leaves the sniper animation, after which it is removed. Smoke_Start and Smoke_End are placeholders made from the Smoke frames: put your own frames in them and keep them not looping. The cloud is scaled by Gunslinger_NPC.SmokeScale and placed bottom-centre on its feet.

Re-arm the smoke bomb: whenever the Gunslinger is not sniping, and on the frame a sniper cycle ends (CanSwitchWeapon), so a sniper shot that repeats drops a fresh bomb. Runs before the drop below, so the first frame of a new cycle still drops one.
Drop the smoke bomb, unless a cloud is already up: clear a fading old cloud, start Smoke_Start, scale it, put it on the feet and draw it in front of the Gunslinger.
Left the sniper animation: play Smoke_End.
Smoke_Start finished: switch to the looping Smoke cloud.
Smoke_End finished: remove the cloud.

Reset the contact timer only while separated. After TouchDashTimeNow seconds of continuous contact (1 in phase 1, 0.4 in phase 2), Gunslinger performs a guaranteed backward retreat dash away from the Player.

Counts player hits; after a random 1-5 hits, Gunslinger dashes. Forward dash direction is based on Gunslinger world side: right half goes left/center, left half goes right/center. Forward dash animation is chosen by direction relative to Player: toward = dash_fwd, away = dash_bwd.
Count each player hit. Hits while posture-broken are ignored. The flag is always cleared. Forward dash animation is chosen by direction relative to Player: toward = dash_fwd, away = dash_bwd.

Adaptive corner recovery: when Gunslinger is near a side boundary, dash inward to a point just beyond or near the Player, clamped safely inside the arena. The target guarantees at least 180 pixels of inward travel. A shorter cooldown allows another recovery attempt if terrain or collision still leaves him trapped.
